itemList.description:
Repairs to BHR 50, 375HP oil lubricated Kirloskar make Sl.No.153C411013 DWT pump set No.3 of 2nd stage at jackwell Kolhar jackwell under M&R water supply to Vijaypur city  for the year 2025-26.
Dismantling The pump set : Work includes dismantling the motor cable, control cables, earthing connections, decoupling the pump and motor coupling, dismantling the bearing cooling connections, dismatling the motor, dismantling the pump coupling, non reversible ratchet unit, draining the oil from trust bearing unit, dismantling the thrust bearing, discharge head delivery pipe connection, complete column pipe, transmission shafts, removing each muff coupling unit with split ring dismantling of single stage bowl assembly unit etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Spares : 
Supply, and delivery at site brand new Suction strainer total stainless steel. etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new Suction Bell Bush. (Phosprous Bronze) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new Impellar casing wear ring (Phosprous Bronze) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new Bowl bush Bearing (Phosprous Bronze) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new Discharge case bush Bearing (Phosprous Bronze) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new Tube adopter Bearing (Phosprous Bronze) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new Threaded Holder (Phosprous Bronze) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new Impellar Neck Ring (CF8M) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Supply, and delivery at site brand new coloumn pipe nut bolts M24 x 150 Hardened (SS) etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Coloumn pipes painting : Painting the colouman pipes with two coats of epoxy paint by cleaning the pipe outside, surface, removing the rusted and corrod pipes. etc...., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Re-erection and Commissioning : Lowering of singale stage bolw assembly unit, erecting intermediate shafts with muff coupling unit, fixing the spider, head shaft, column pipes, fixing discharge head, making the pump base alighnment by using master level, pump foundation base level has to be made by adding required suitable copper or stainless steel sims, connecting delivery pipe line, fixing the thrust bearing unit, fixing the non reversible ratchet unit, impeller float setting, pump coupling, motor stool, erecting motor, connecting motor cable, control cables, earthing connections and commissioning the pump successfully. ect.., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in charge. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents

Transportation : Transportation of Bowl assembly form work site kolhar to egency for repair and back to kolhar jackwell after repair with Loading & Unloading. ---- All terms and conditions are as per uploaded Bid Documents
